notes: Telegram Channel > Queue: Edit and Delete moved into each post's Details popup (the row itself now only shows Confirm/Reject/Retry, whichever apply), and each row shows a small progress bar under its scheduled time indicating how close it is to publishing. New Settings > Signature section lets you add a fixed signature to every outgoing post, with its own on/off toggle. New: personal Telegram alerts. Account menu > Alerts (top-right, next to Update) lets you add people to be DMed by the bot - after they open a one-time link and press Start in Telegram - whenever a new service is added, an existing service changes and needs translation, new content needs translation, or a post is about to be sent to the channel (configurable minutes ahead, with the same text+image preview). Requires 'Update database' after installing this update (adds one table and one column).
